title: Payroll roster and terminations, January to June 2026
what_it_shows: 7 active employees by role: President and CEO, Operations Manager, Lending Manager, Accounting and Compliance Officer, Senior Member Service Representative and 2 Member Service Representatives; 1 termination in the period, an MSR whose last working day was 2026-03-13; payroll is run by an outside payroll service

title: Core user list, role profiles and sign-in settings
what_it_shows: Named user accounts assigned to 4 role profiles (teller, lending, accounting, supervisor); all 3 MSRs hold the supervisor override profile; sign-in is allowed only from the office's fixed IP address over TLS; teller users sign in with a password and the core offers no MFA option for them; lockout and idle session timeout are set by the core processor; no record of a user access review

title: Core report list and exception report binder
source_system: Core reporting (SYS-01); report binder at the operations desk
what_it_shows: The core produces daily user activity, supervisor override, dormant-account and employee-account exception reports; the printed reports are filed in a binder with no reviewer sign-off; the core's BSA module produces alerts for the BSA Officer

title: Online banking admin console users, member authentication and alert settings
what_it_shows: 5 staff admin console users, all with MFA; members sign in with a user name and password, and a text code is required only when a new device is registered; member alerts for changes to email, phone and payees are turned off; changes to member contact data and payees are written to the console audit log; the provider's fraud scoring holds suspicious sign-ins and transfers for staff review; e-statement consent is recorded for each member

title: Wire portal maker, approver and token list
what_it_shows: The Senior MSR holds the maker role; the Operations Manager and the Accounting and Compliance Officer hold approver roles; each maker and approver has a hardware token; the portal requires approval by a second user before an outgoing wire is released; per-user limits are set

title: Productivity suite users, MFA, mailbox and audit settings
source_system: Productivity suite admin console (SYS-04), exported by the MSP
what_it_shows: Named accounts for the 7 employees, each with MFA; the Member Services mailbox is a licensed user account created in 2018, excluded from the MFA policy and signed into directly with a password; its password change log shows no change since before 2026-03-13; the mailbox holds about 3 years of email; sign-in logs are kept for the plan's default period of less than one year; no alert rules for new forwarding rules or unusual sign-ins; no rule encrypts outside mail; TLS between mail servers; deleted-item retention only, with no separate mailbox backup

title: Intake interview: accounts, the shared mailbox and member processes
what_it_shows: Accounts are requested verbally; the Operations Manager sets up core, admin console, wire portal and LOS users and the MSP sets up suite and device accounts; the 3 MSRs and the Operations Manager share the Member Services mailbox password, and the mailbox receives loan documents with Social Security numbers, ID copies and wire request forms from members; nobody reviews core reports, admin console logs, wire portal activity or suite sign-ins; member phone number changes are accepted by phone; in 2025 a member's online banking was taken over after a phone number change, the loss was refunded, and no written record was kept

title: MSP device list
source_system: MSP remote monitoring and management console
what_it_shows: 8 desktops (4 teller and member service stations, 1 wire and new-accounts desk, 1 accounting, 1 lending, 1 operations) and 3 laptops (President and CEO, Operations Manager, Lending Manager); 2 check scanners attached to teller stations; the MSP agent also runs on the imaging server; the list has no SaaS services and does not record where member information is stored

title: MSP device policy and encryption report
source_system: MSP remote monitoring and management console
what_it_shows: Full-disk encryption on the 3 laptops; not enabled on the 8 desktops, including the wire and new-accounts desk; staff accounts have no local administrator rights; a 10-minute screen lock applies except on the 4 teller stations, which are exempted at staff request; the MSP can wipe the laptops remotely

title: MSP monthly service report, June 2026
source_system: MSP report emailed to the Operations Manager
what_it_shows: Monthly operating system patching of the endpoints and the imaging server; firewall firmware updated; antivirus on all computers and the imaging server; the services listed do not include vulnerability scanning, endpoint detection and response, or restore tests

title: Antivirus console export
what_it_shows: Signature antivirus active on the 11 computers and the imaging server with automatic definition updates; alerts go to the MSP help desk queue, which is staffed in business hours; no alert is sent to the credit union; no behavior-based detection agent is installed; the suite filters inbound email

title: Firewall and Wi-Fi configuration export
source_system: MSP network documentation and firewall management
what_it_shows: The firewall blocks unsolicited inbound traffic and exposes no management interface to the internet; staff Wi-Fi uses WPA2-Enterprise with named accounts; guest Wi-Fi is a separate network with internet access only; the VoIP phones use the same internet line as the office; the MSP keeps a backup of the firewall configuration

title: Imaging server cloud account export
source_system: Cloud provider console for SYS-09, exported by the MSP
what_it_shows: One virtual server in a cloud account held in the MSP's name; provider-managed disk encryption on; network rules allow connections only from the office IP address; daily snapshots kept 14 days in the same account; one administrator login, with no MFA registered and no separate role for deleting snapshots; console activity log on the default retention; the credit union has no login to the account

title: MSP response on imaging server administration
source_system: Email from the MSP lead technician
what_it_shows: States that two MSP technicians use the cloud console administrator login and that no snapshot has ever been restored

title: MSP ticket history, January 2024 to June 2026
what_it_shows: Tickets close the retirement of 2 desktops in 2024 with no wipe or destruction record attached; firewall, endpoint and cloud tenant changes are opened by MSP technicians, with no approval by the credit union recorded; account requests are opened from the Operations Manager's emails; no restore or continuity test tickets

title: Information security program and policy manual
what_it_shows: Written program and policy manual from a trade association template, adopted by the board in 2019; no revision or review record since 2019; includes the credit union's record retention schedule; does not mention online banking, the document imaging server or the Member Services mailbox

title: Board minutes, January 2019 to June 2026
source_system: Board minutes binder (President and CEO's office)
what_it_shows: The board adopted the program in 2019 and has not re-approved it since; the last information security report to the board was in 2022; no written designation of an Information Security Officer; the board reviews the fidelity bond each year; SAR filings are reported to the board at the next meeting

title: 2019 risk assessment questionnaire
what_it_shows: Trade association template questionnaire with yes/no answers on generic threats; no likelihood or impact ratings; no later risk assessment was provided

title: 2025 NCUA examination report
what_it_shows: The examination recommended that the credit union update its information security risk assessment

title: Part 748 compliance certifications and Credit Union Profile
source_system: NCUA Credit Union Profile filing records
what_it_shows: The President and CEO certified compliance with Part 748 in the Credit Union Profile each year, most recently in January 2026; the profile shows a federal charter, share insurance by the NCUA, a one-county Florida community field of membership, and share, share draft, certificate, consumer loan, first mortgage, online banking, debit card and wire services, with no brokerage, investment advisory or insurance services

title: 2019 incident response plan
what_it_shows: Steps to contain, call the MSP, call the cyber insurer's breach hotline and recover; names the manager as lead and the MSP as technical responder; lists the insurer's hotline and the MSP emergency line; no step for a report to NCUA or a member notice; no definition of a reportable incident; no review since 2019; folder access limited to management

title: 2019 business continuity plan and vital records preservation log
what_it_shows: Continuity plan dated 2019 with no test record; no step for the catastrophic act report; the records preservation log and the designated staff date from 2019

title: 2019 wire transfer procedure
what_it_shows: Names the Senior MSR as maker and the Operations Manager and the Accounting and Compliance Officer as approvers; no callback step; no written security procedure agreed with members

title: Training sign-in sheets
what_it_shows: Annual BSA training signed by all 7 employees; the security awareness video signed by each employee at hire; no other security training, reminders or phishing exercises recorded

title: Document request response
what_it_shows: Requests for user access review records, log review records, restore, continuity or alternate wire test records, an incident log, computer disposal records, change approval records, and a validation, fair lending or reason-code review of the AI scoring add-on returned none

title: Employee handbook, 2019 edition
what_it_shows: Code of ethics and conduct for employees

title: Privacy notice
what_it_shows: Privacy notice under Regulation P; member information is shared only under the notice exceptions, so no opt-out is offered

title: Core processing contract
what_it_shows: Core processing for shares, loans, general ledger, teller, ACH and the BSA module; ACH files posted at the processor's data center; confidentiality clause; renews 2027-06-30; no time frame for notice of security incidents to the credit union

title: Core processor SOC 1 Type 2 and SOC 2 Type 2 reports
source_system: Core processor client portal; SOC report folder
what_it_shows: Both reports cover the 12 months ending 2026-03-31; production and backup run at two data centers; stated recovery objectives of RTO 8 hours and RPO 15 minutes; vendor encryption at rest, lockout and session timeout described; complementary user entity controls listed; no review notes in the folder

title: Digital banking provider service agreement and SOC 2 Type 2 report
source_system: Contracts folder; provider client portal; SOC report folder
what_it_shows: Service agreement with a confidentiality clause; SOC 2 Type 2 report on file; its system description states RTO 4 hours and RPO 15 minutes and TLS for member sessions; no review notes in the folder

title: Card processor and ATM vendor agreements
what_it_shows: The card processor issues and processes debit cards, runs fraud monitoring and authorizes in stand-in mode with limits when the core is down; the ATM vendor services the lobby ATM; the card processor's SOC report is in the folder with no review notes

title: Wire service agreement and alternate wire instructions
what_it_shows: Maker-checker and hardware token terms; a wire service availability statement; settlement through the corporate credit union; a phone-initiated wire with a PIN as the alternate procedure

title: MSP service contract
what_it_shows: Help desk, patching, antivirus, firewall and Wi-Fi, productivity suite administration and imaging server administration; 4-business-hour response time and an after-hours emergency line; no recovery time commitment; no incident notice time frame; a confidentiality clause and no other security requirements; no list of technicians or subcontractors; describes the remote management tool used to reach every computer and the imaging server

title: LOS agreement, AI scoring add-on terms and configuration
what_it_shows: Vendor change notice: the AI credit scoring add-on was switched on 2026-04-06 at the Lending Manager's request; it scores online consumer auto and personal loan applications up to $25,000, approves applications above the approve cutoff automatically and routes the rest to the Lending Manager, with up to 4 reason codes; inputs include credit report attributes and vendor digital identity signals; the add-on terms allow the vendor to use de-identified application data to improve its models; the LOS agreement has a confidentiality clause and no other security requirements; 2 LOS staff users, both with MFA; no vendor SOC 2 report in the file

title: Internet and phone service agreement
what_it_shows: One business fiber line; the VoIP phones run on the same line; no second line or failover service

title: Fidelity bond, cyber insurance policy and renewal notice
what_it_shows: Fidelity bond with notice-of-loss terms; cyber policy with a 24x7 breach hotline, panel breach counsel and forensics, and a $100,000 social engineering fraud sublimit; the cyber policy renews on 2026-11-01 and the renewal notice asks for the renewal questionnaire by 2026-10-31

title: Accounts payable vendor list, July 2025 to June 2026
what_it_shows: Recurring payments to the core processor, digital banking provider, corporate credit union, card processor, ATM vendor, LOS vendor (with an AI scoring add-on fee from April 2026), consumer reporting agencies, productivity suite vendor, MSP (including the imaging server's cloud hosting), shredding vendor, internet provider, payroll service, alarm company, outside CPA firm, and the bond and cyber insurers; no charges from other AI tool vendors

title: Vendor security documentation
source_system: Vendor websites and portals (productivity suite, digital banking provider, cloud IaaS provider)
what_it_shows: The suite vendor, digital banking provider and IaaS provider describe encryption of stored data, TLS in transit, and account lockout after repeated failed sign-ins; the IaaS provider publishes compliance reports and a shared responsibility description

title: Supervisory committee audit engagement letter and FY2025 audit report
what_it_shows: The outside CPA firm performs the annual financial statement audit for the Supervisory Committee; the engagement letter does not include testing of security controls

title: Key log, alarm contract and camera settings
source_system: President and CEO's files; camera system
what_it_shows: Office keys held by the President and CEO and the Operations Manager; alarm monitoring contract in force; camera recordings kept 90 days

title: Shredding vendor certificates, 2025 to 2026
what_it_shows: Certificates for paper shredding; no certificates or wipe records for computers or drives

title: SAR log (reviewed by the ISO; contents not copied)
what_it_shows: SARs filed by the BSA Officer from core BSA module alerts, with filing dates

title: Core procedures: offline teller mode and account holds
source_system: Core processor user guide; operations desk procedures
what_it_shows: Offline teller mode uses a balance file downloaded each night to the wire and new-accounts desk, listing each member's name, address and balances; it allows withdrawals up to $500 per member per day and deposits that post when the core returns; staff can place holds and freeze accounts in the core

title: FY2025 financial statements
what_it_shows: Total assets of $60.0 million; a $41 million loan portfolio; net revenue (income after dividends paid to members) of about $1.1 million across about 250 business days, about $4,400 per business day

title: Member and activity report, Q2 2026
source_system: Core reporting (SYS-01); admin console, wire portal and LOS reports
what_it_shows: About 6,400 members; about 3,900 enrolled in online and mobile banking; about 5,200 active debit cards; about 60 lobby and drive-up transactions a day; about 25 outgoing wires a month (average about $38,000; largest in 2025 $310,000); about 900 consumer loan applications in the last 12 months; mailing addresses held in the core

title: Staff AI tool survey
what_it_shows: The Lending Manager names the LOS AI scoring add-on; staff responses mention public generative AI chatbots used to draft letters or answer questions; the survey did not record how many staff use them or what was entered; no list of approved AI tools exists in the documents provided

title: BIA interviews with process owners
source_system: Interviews (President and CEO, Operations Manager, Accounting and Compliance Officer, Lending Manager, Senior MSR, MSP lead technician)
what_it_shows: Each owner's description of their process, the systems, vendors and people it uses, its manual workaround, and the longest outage and data loss they say the process can tolerate

title: Risk assessment interviews
source_system: Interviews (all 7 employees and the MSP lead technician)
what_it_shows: Owners' accounts of past events and near misses, including the 2025 account takeover after a phone number change; how wire requests, member documents and member contact changes are handled; the MSP lead technician describes the remote management tool, which reaches every computer and the imaging server, with no MFA evidence or technician list supplied

title: Interview with the President and CEO on incident reporting
what_it_shows: States that the 2019 plan has no NCUA reporting step, criteria or contact, and that staff assumed vendors would notify members after a vendor incident

title: Interview with the Senior MSR on wire requests
what_it_shows: Staff call a member back only when something seems off; wire requests are accepted by email; there is no written wire security procedure with members

title: Wire request file sample, June 2026
source_system: Wire files (10 outgoing wires from June 2026)
what_it_shows: 10 wire files: 4 requested by email; 1 with a callback note

title: Office walk-through
what_it_shows: Keyed entry, alarm, vault and cameras; locked network closet; wire tokens kept in a locked drawer; check scanners at the teller stations save scanned member documents on the teller station desktops

title: Member Services mailbox walk-through
source_system: Productivity suite (SYS-04), with the MSP lead technician
what_it_shows: The mailbox holds loan documents with Social Security numbers, ID copies and wire request forms going back about 3 years; sent items show member documents sent to members without message encryption

title: Gap analysis interviews
source_system: Interviews (all 7 employees and the MSP lead technician)
what_it_shows: Owners' descriptions of how each Part 748, Appendix A and Appendix B item is carried out today, including vendor selection, change handling, evidence preservation and contact with law enforcement; staff state that member documents are emailed without message encryption

title: Personnel file sample
what_it_shows: Background checks completed before hire for the 3 sampled employees

title: MSP quotes for technical treatments
source_system: Email from the MSP lead technician
what_it_shows: Quoted prices for MSP-managed EDR with alert monitoring on 11 computers and the imaging server (about $2,100 a year), a cellular failover router (about $400 one-time and $360 a year), and desktop encryption, MFA setup, mailbox conversion and restore tests (about $1,500 of MSP time); quarterly external vulnerability scans offered

title: Wire request file sample, July 2026
source_system: Wire files (10 outgoing wires from July 2026)
what_it_shows: 10 wire files: 6 requested by email, and 1 of those 6 with a callback note

title: MSP change record: Member Services mailbox conversion
what_it_shows: The MSP converted the Member Services mailbox to a delegated shared mailbox reached through each person's named account with MFA, and reset its password, on 2026-08-12

title: LOS pilot application and decline notice report
what_it_shows: 212 applications scored from 2026-04-06 to 2026-08-14: 97 approved automatically; 115 referred (model recommended decline on 52 and refer on 63); of the referred, 61 approved, 45 declined, and 9 withdrawn or incomplete; 9 of the 45 decline notices gave a score-only reason; override reasons not recorded before August

title: Board minutes and resolutions, 2026-08-25
what_it_shows: The board approved the updated information security program and POL-02 to POL-04 (effective 2026-09-01), designated the Operations Manager as Information Security Officer in writing, received the annual information security report and the risk register summary, and approved the High-risk treatment plans

title: Control assessment: account management test
source_system: Core, admin console, wire portal, LOS and suite user lists compared with the payroll roster (EV-001); termination record for the former MSR; ISO and MSP lead technician interviews
what_it_shows: The former MSR's core account was still enabled on 2026-08-05, about 5 months after her last day; core sign-in logs show no use after that day; the account was disabled the same day; account types, approvals and procedures are not documented; account requests are verbal; no account review in any system; the shared mailbox password known to her was not changed; the other user lists match named staff

title: Control assessment: wire separation of duties review
source_system: 2019 wire procedure; wire portal role and administrator report; token assignment list; ISO interview
what_it_shows: The 2019 procedure and the portal configuration name the maker and approver duties; the Operations Manager holds both the wire portal administrator role and an approver token

title: Control assessment: administrator MFA sign-in tests
source_system: Admin console and wire portal MFA settings; suite administrator accounts; sign-in test to the cloud console with the MSP present
what_it_shows: MFA required on the admin console, the wire portal (hardware tokens) and suite administrator accounts; the MSP's cloud console login accepted a password alone and is used by two technicians

title: Control assessment: non-privileged MFA sign-in tests
source_system: Suite MFA report; Member Services mailbox sign-in test with the MSR who normally signs in; core teller sign-in
what_it_shows: Named suite accounts require MFA; the Member Services mailbox accepted a direct password sign-in without a second factor; core teller users sign in with a password from the office IP address

title: Control assessment: personnel termination review
source_system: Termination record for the former MSR; personnel file; ISO interview
what_it_shows: No time limit set for disabling access; the core account stayed enabled 5 months; the shared mailbox password known to the former MSR was not changed; no exit discussion of the confidentiality duty; office key and alarm code card returned on the last day; her named mailbox retained and reassigned to the ISO

title: Control assessment: training records and staff interviews
source_system: Training materials and sign-in sheets; interviews with 5 of 7 staff
what_it_shows: The security video at hire does not cover BEC, changed wire instructions, look-alike addresses, pretext calls or social mining; no instruction on how to report a suspected attempt; the 5 staff interviewed gave 3 different answers on how to report

title: Control assessment: log review interviews
source_system: Core exception and user reports; admin console audit log; wire portal activity report; suite sign-in log; ISO interview
what_it_shows: No audit record is reviewed in any system; core exception reports are printed and filed with no review; no review results are reported

title: Control assessment: backup configuration review
source_system: Cloud snapshot policy and console; suite retention settings; MSP monthly report (July 2026); MSP lead technician interview
what_it_shows: The imaging server is snapshotted daily and the snapshots kept 14 days, encrypted by the provider; the same login that runs the server can delete or change the snapshots; no copy outside the account; snapshots never restored; suite mailboxes and shared files have only vendor deleted-item retention; security documents and the incident plan are kept only in the suite and a paper binder; the July 2026 MSP report shows monthly patching of the endpoints and the imaging server

title: Control assessment: contingency test review
source_system: 2019 business continuity plan; MSP records; corporate credit union alternate wire instructions; ISO and MSP interviews
what_it_shows: The continuity plan has never been tested; the MSP confirmed that no imaging restore record exists; the alternate phone wire has never been tried; no test criteria for effectiveness or readiness

title: Control assessment: staff reporting interviews
source_system: 2019 incident plan; draft POL-03; interviews with 5 of 7 staff and the President and CEO
what_it_shows: No reporting time or channel; the 5 staff interviewed named 3 different people to call; no step or NCUA contact for the 72-hour report or the Appendix B notice to the Regional Director; POL-03 was a draft

title: Control assessment: incident response plan review
source_system: 2019 incident plan; shared folder permissions; President and CEO and ISO interviews
what_it_shows: The 2019 plan gives basic steps, names the manager as lead and the MSP as technical responder, and lists the insurer's hotline and the MSP emergency line; it does not address wire fraud, member notice, SARs or vendor-hosted systems, defines no reportable incident, has no metrics, and has not been reviewed or updated since 2019; copies only in a management shared folder, with edit rights limited to the ISO and the President and CEO; the MSP and the insurer contact do not have the plan

title: Control assessment: risk assessment documents
source_system: P01 risk register (2026-07-24); 2019 questionnaire; board minutes
what_it_shows: 2026 risk register completed 2026-07-24 with SP 800-30 tables; no review or update of the risk assessment between 2019 and 2026; the 2026 register had not been given to the board at fieldwork

title: Control assessment: vendor agreement review
source_system: Core, digital banking, wire service, MSP and LOS contracts; SOC report folder; ISO interview
what_it_shows: Each contract includes a GLBA confidentiality clause; the MSP and LOS contracts set no other security requirements; the core contract sets no incident notice time frame; SOC reports filed with no review notes; complementary user entity controls not mapped; the MSP technician list and MFA evidence requested on 2026-07-28 were not received by fieldwork end
